name: pf-fix-farming-dual-joints
about: fix-farming-dual-joints against the built package town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Fix (farming): two joints at once. `hwp joint wield off` puts a Lucky Leaf joint in the off hand, `hwp joint wield main` an Ember Kush one in the main hand (its hwp_joint_mh_* twin, as a bag click on a second joint does through core's HWP::Bag::OnEquip). Right click puffs the off-hand joint (5/5 -> 4/5, the main hand untouched), left click the main-hand one; both herb buffs are on at once (mission-buff slots hwp_herb and hwp_herb2); a twin back in the bag is the off-hand joint again. Shot: dual-joints.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:farming\] self-check done: 8 seeds, 3 herb buffs, 30 joint items
steps.name: the module loaded with every joint item (both hands)
